import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.JacobianDataCharts
import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.Genus0Terminal

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace ProbeR2

open AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

-- Probe 1: is the identity structure morphism lft/qc free?
example : LocallyOfFiniteType (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))).hom := by
  change LocallyOfFiniteType (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  infer_instance

example : QuasiCompact (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))).hom := by
  change QuasiCompact (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  infer_instance

-- Probe 3: the representation by the terminal object from vanishing.
noncomputable example (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))) where
  homEquiv {T} :=
    { toFun := fun _ => 1
      invFun := fun _ => Over.mkIdTerminal.from T
      left_inv := fun f => (Over.mkIdTerminal.hom_ext _ _)
      right_inv := fun x => @Subsingleton.elim (pic0Subgroup C T) (h T) 1 x }
  homEquiv_comp {T T'} g x := by
    haveI : Subsingleton ((pic0TypeFunctor C).obj (op T)) := h T
    apply Subsingleton.elim

-- Probe 4: the RING-LEVEL reduction. `picEt C T` is a subgroup of a PRODUCT over
-- affine opens, so componentwise subsingletons suffice — no cover, no naturality.
example (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A], Subsingleton (PicEtAff C A))
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subsingleton (picEt C T) := by
  refine ⟨fun s t => picEt.ext fun U => ?_⟩
  exact @Subsingleton.elim _ (h Γ(T.left, U.1)) _ _

-- Probe 5: hence pic0Subgroup is subsingleton, being a subgroup of it.
example (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A], Subsingleton (PicEtAff C A))
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T) := by
  haveI : Subsingleton (picEt C T) := ⟨fun s t => picEt.ext fun U =>
    @Subsingleton.elim _ (h Γ(T.left, U.1)) _ _⟩
  exact ⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

-- Probe 6: bot vs Subsingleton for a subgroup
example (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (h : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    pic0Subgroup C T = ⊥ := by
  haveI := h
  exact (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr fun x hx =>
    congrArg Subtype.val (Subsingleton.elim (⟨x, hx⟩ : pic0Subgroup C T) 1)

-- Probe 7: the CONVERSE of the affine reduction (so it is not a weakening)
example (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (picEt C T))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Subsingleton (PicEtAff C A) :=
  haveI := h (overSpec k A)
  (picEtAffineEquiv C A).toEquiv.symm.subsingleton

-- Probe 8: the preimage containment fromSpecAffine needs.
example (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
    (overSpecTopAffine Γ(T.left, U.1)).1
      ≤ (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := by
  show ⊤ ≤ _
  rw [top_le_iff]
  exact U.2.fromSpec_preimage_self

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

end ProbeR2
